title: Implement authoritative Artifact / ArtifactRelation resource layer
final_head_policy: The exact final pushed PR head and exact-head GitHub Actions runs are recorded in the PR/final handoff; later pushes invalidate earlier CI evidence. This file does not contain its own SHA to avoid self-referential evidence.
authority_chain: Account -> Organization membership -> Project -> Artifact -> ArtifactRelation

artifact_authority_model.identity: Server-generated UUID via newId() / randomUUID, never client/provider supplied
artifact_authority_model.ownership: Canonical projects.id FK; tenant resolved Artifact -> Project -> Organization -> membership on every decision
artifact_authority_model.type_rule: Bounded syntax-validated typed-output token (non-empty, trimmed, <= 200 chars); NOT a closed canonical enum and NOT a normalized registry (VF-PRJ-017 remains deferred)
artifact_authority_model.integrity: FK to projects, CHECK non-empty type, provider authority keys rejected

artifact_relation_authority_model.project_ownership: Derived from canonical endpoint Artifacts; endpoints must resolve to the same Project (cross-Project rejected even within one Organization)
integrity: unique (project_id, subject, relation_kind, object) duplicate-edge rejection
relation_kind CHECK restricted to the four canonical kinds
artifact_relation_authority_model.db_backstop: Composite foreign keys make a cross-Project edge impossible at the database level even if service checks are bypassed

persistence.server_authority: id via newId(), timestamps via now(), projectId via requireId, type via requireBoundedToken, relationKind via canonical-kind guard, rejectProviderAuthority

authorization_integration.decision_boundary: TenantAuthorizationService.authorize returns explicit allow/deny, never throws for outcome

negative_paths.forged_project_id: unknown_resource or no_membership via FK and authz
negative_paths.stale_tenant_info: client org/project claim ignored, canonical persistence used

authorization_integration.service_layer: @vibeflow/project ArtifactService uses authz for create (project check) and read (artifact/artifact_relation check)

audit_integration.authorization_audit: AuthorizationAuditRecorder records artifact and artifact_relation decisions; organization_id resolved by joining through canonical Project ownership
audit_integration.artifact_scope_sql: SELECT p.organization_id FROM artifacts a JOIN projects p ON p.id = a.project_id WHERE a.id = $1
audit_integration.relation_scope_sql: SELECT p.organization_id FROM artifact_relations r JOIN projects p ON p.id = r.project_id WHERE r.id = $1
audit_integration.scope_resolution_failure: Database errors while resolving canonical Organization scope propagate to TenantAuthorizationService; an otherwise-allowed decision is converted to DENY audit_unavailable instead of writing an unscoped allowed event. Missing resources still resolve to zero rows and may remain account-scoped denial evidence.
audit_integration.metadata_safety: sanitizeAuditMetadata omits secret keys and redacts secret values, rejects authority-shaped keys

api_service_boundary.exposed: Minimal create/read/list surface to prove resource authority; no transform/publish/export/import/version/archive/delete/lifecycle
client_supplied: projectId (checked via membership, not trusted as authority, for artifact create)

unit.decision: updated to assert inclusion of canonical resource types (organization, project, artifact, artifact_relation) rather than an exact list

runners: pnpm run check executes package Vitest suites, including packages/audit/src/artifact-scope.live.test.ts
scripts/run-m013-artifact-integration.py runs persistence, authorization, project live suites

suites.persistence: packages/persistence/src/artifact.live.test.ts: canonical creation, type token, tenant-safe list, unknown UUID, provider authority rejection, forged FK, same-project relation, unknown endpoint, cross-project relation, self-edge, duplicate edge, invalid kind, DB composite-FK backstop, indexes
suites.authorization: packages/authorization/src/artifact.live.test.ts: same-tenant read, cross-tenant read, forged actor, unknown UUID, revoked membership, canonical persistence, relation read success/cross-tenant/unknown
suites.project_service: packages/project/src/artifact.live.test.ts: creation, same-tenant read, cross-tenant read/create, forged project/actor, unknown UUID, revoked membership, canonical persistence + audit scoping, same-project relation, unknown endpoint, cross-project same-org relation, cross-tenant relation, forged relation id, tenant-safe list
suites.audit_scope_failure: packages/audit/src/artifact-scope.live.test.ts proves a forced canonical Artifact and ArtifactRelation audit-scope query failure converts an otherwise-valid ALLOW to audit_unavailable and persists no false allowed audit row

live_postgres.build_isolation: packages/audit/tsconfig.json excludes src/artifact-scope.live.test.ts from production tsc build while Vitest still executes it
live_postgres.status_at_evidence_creation: NOT EXECUTED locally (no DATABASE_URL); must be executed in CI exact-head; not represented as PASS

local_checks.test: 16/16 packages PASS (live skipped without DB, expected)

capability_status.VF-PRJ-013: IMPLEMENTED (Artifact: authoritative typed-output metadata rooted in canonical Project ownership)
capability_status.VF-PRJ-001: NOT_STARTED (Artifact Registry includes Library/sidebar product behavior beyond a bare authority table)
capability_status.VF-PRJ-002: NOT_STARTED (ArtifactVersion content-addressed lifecycle out of scope)
capability_status.VF-PRJ-017: NOT_STARTED (Typed Artifact Graph requires normalized type-registry semantics not defined by M-013)
capability_status.rationale: M-013 implements durable Artifact metadata and durable ArtifactRelation edges rooted in canonical Project ownership, tenant/resource authorization, durable audit, and PostgreSQL composite-FK integrity. No closed type taxonomy or normalized registry was invented.

known_limitations: Artifact `type` is a bounded syntax-validated token, not a normalized registry; VF-PRJ-017 remains deferred.
No ArtifactGraph / Canvas product capability (VF-PRJ-003, DEFER).
No imports/templates (M-014), full Project lifecycle E2E (M-015), provider bindings (M-016+).
No durable artifact.* event names invented: EVENT_CATALOG.yaml defines no Artifact event, so none was added.
PostgreSQL live suites require DATABASE_URL and are not executed locally; CI must run them exact-head.
M-013 remains REVIEW, not DONE, until independent review and merge.
out_of_scope_confirmed: M-013 does not add provider/repository/workspace/blob/object-storage ids or byte ownership to Artifact.
M-013 does not add lifecycle status, version fields, blob URLs, or external ownership to Artifact.
M-013 does not introduce new durable artifact.* event names.
M-014 imports/templates, M-015 project lifecycle E2E, M-016+ provider bindings not implemented.
overclaim_check: M-013 is REVIEW, not DONE. VF-PRJ-013 is IMPLEMENTED, not VERIFIED/COMPLETE. PostgreSQL live is not claimed locally. M-014+ remain LOCKED. No Artifact event contract was invented.
